extDescription.message: See the sender in your Zerosoft CRM, log emails and track opens from Gmail.

panelToggle.message: Show or hide the CRM panel

errNotConfigured.message: Connect the extension to your workspace first.

errInvalidKey.message: Your token is not valid or was revoked. Paste a new one in the extension settings.

errScope.message: Your token cannot do this. Create one with CRM read and write access.

errNetwork.message: Couldn't reach Zerosoft. Check the app URL in the extension settings.

errRateLimited.message: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.

errReloaded.message: The extension was updated. Reload Gmail.

notConfigured.message: Paste your app URL and personal API token to see your contacts here.

emptyNoEmail.message: Open an email to see who sent it.

logNoContact.message: Create the contact first to log this email.

notInCrm.message: This person is not in your CRM yet.

taskSubjectRequired.message: Write what needs to be done.

trackDone.message: Email logged. You will see opens in the CRM.

trackFailed.message: Couldn't log this email. It was sent without tracking.

trackHint.message: Log this email in the CRM and track opens

optionsIntro.message: Connect the extension with a personal API token. It acts as you: it sees the same contacts and deals you see in the CRM.

optionsTokenHint.message: Create it in Settings, Workspace, API keys, with CRM read and write access. It is stored only in this browser.

optionsTrackDefault.message: Log and track new emails by default

optionsReadOnly.message: This token can only read: creating contacts, tasks and logging emails will fail.

optionsBadUrl.message: Enter the address where you open Zerosoft, like https://zerosoft.ai.

optionsBadToken.message: The token starts with zs_. Copy it again from API keys.

optionsPermissionDenied.message: Chrome needs permission to reach that address. Save again and accept.

optionsDisconnected.message: Token removed. The panel stays off until you paste a new one.

templateMissing.message: Template inserted. Some fields were empty for this recipient, check the text.
